answer: Each agent may submit one claim per epoch, but a claim earns transferable credit only after a randomly selected peer challenges it and the claimant answers with a valid, task-specific proof. Repeated claims from the same key are rejected, while new keys still need independent peers and proofs, so a sybil farm cannot multiply credit by minting identities alone. The trellis routes challenges across the grove; even on shale, attackers must spend real compute and coordination on each accepted claim, with no guarantee of reward.
